claim: Local automated ordinary production +itemdex/+inventory/+party/+use/+deposit/+evolve command/model acceptance with real private PostgreSQL, captured session transport and actual durable BattleSession rebuilds.
scope: two existing Bottle Caps through shared fresh owned field target/transaction checks
persistent effective-IV overlay in existing flags, separate from genetic IVs
shared/party stats, battle factories, native forms and checkpoint compatibility
ordinary discovery, documentation, lifecycle CI and source-pinned command/SQL evidence

rules.generation: Generation 9-style level 50 minimum; saved EXP and level must agree for canonical species growth rate
rules.Bottle Cap: Require one exact full stat name or published alias; train that stat if genetic IV <31 and not already marked
rules.Gold Bottle Cap: No selector; train every remaining eligible stat, skipping perfect/already-trained stats
rules.persistent_contract: OwnedPokemon.flags stores hypertrained:<stat>; old rows without markers retain genetic behavior. No schema change or migration required.
rules.genetics: Genetic ivs stay unchanged in SQL, stat input arrays/dictionaries and battle snapshots. Effective 31 is a separate calculation overlay, never an inheritance value.
rules.HP: Preserve zero HP for fainted targets and absolute HP deficit for living targets when maximum HP changes; status remains unchanged
rules.guards: Fresh canonical owned party/current-Fusion, egg/box/reservation/battle/stock checks; exact stat selector; consistent level/EXP, valid IVs/EVs/markers and native eligible species. Reject unknown, transformed and battle/item/ability-locked forms.
rules.atomicity: Useful training flags, HP and one bag debit commit together. Failed/partial debit, post-SQL save fault and parent rollback cannot leak training or success notices. Waiting requests reread current flags and stock.
rules.snapshots: Independent optional hyper_training payload; owned legacy snapshots recover flags, standalone old/malformed payloads default to no boost. Temporary battle scaling below 50 retains earned training.
rules.preservation: Evolution and native-form stat recalculation retain training; identity, species, placement, genetics, EVs, held item, friendship, status and moves are unchanged by cap use
rules.metadata: Existing dex definitions: Generation 7, IDs 795/796, Fling 30. Supplement only gameplay descriptions; no price or stock added. Current availability belongs to #772

source_hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 normalized LF text; compare all relevant staged and committed blobs before publication

setup_and_cleanup.fixture_setup: Fresh private loopback PostgreSQL, isolated schemas, tagged normal User owners, canonical slot-3 level-50 Eevee, genetic IVs 0..5, calculated HP/stats, real Trainer bag stock and gapped active moves 1/4. Explicit negative SQL fixture updates intentionally leave stale cached values.
setup_and_cleanup.transport_adapters: Capture session output, delegate production player storage/identity and run real parse/func, item service, transaction, evolution and battle construction. Real BattleSession starts and persists/rebuilds twice; only opponent selection/search and transport are adapted. No successful item effect is mocked.
setup_and_cleanup.negative_injection: Only failure cases substitute debit return or inject a fault after real SQL save. Independent synchronized SQL connections exercise last-copy, duplicate-stat, different-stat, different-target and mixed-cap contention.
setup_and_cleanup.cleanup: All isolated schemas removed, public tables empty, private task cluster stopped. No existing game database, human character, game service or migration runner used.

preliminary_diagnosis: Initial 28-case run had seven ANSI text-comparison fixture failures, an unsaved-level fixture, an old held model-reference assertion (independent SQL already had merged flags), and a real missing required-item form guard for Gengar-Mega.

Added the locked native-form guard; fixture checks strip ANSI, persist setup level/EXP and resolve current cache state after detached progression saves. No shared field-target or concurrency implementation change was needed.
Second run exposed a level-1 fixture HP deficit below zero; bounded fixture HP with max(1, calculated max HP minus 17).
Expanded targeted run passed 29/29, including a transformed-target regression; final acceptance below reruns the frozen sources with all affected suites.
